lines.speaker: fenwick
lines.text: The lodging is sorted, and I have found the hearth Tharr mentioned. It is not much yet, but I can work with it. Get some rest tonight. Tomorrow we start making this place livable.

lines.speaker: fenwick
lines.text: The hearth draws well, but the room around it needs a roof and a proper flue. A kitchen is only as good as the walls that keep the rain out of the soup.

lines.speaker: fenwick
lines.text: The kitchen is open. Bring me ingredients and I will turn them into something worth eating. A well-fed party fights better, works harder, and complains less. Mostly less.
